records.heading: Appendix E - Sample Submittal Forms (PDF)
path: Unified Development Code - nineteen Chapters and eleven Appendices on official index
records.text:
Appendix E
SAMPLE BOND FORMS
On the following pages are sample forms to use as a guide in the preparation of bonds and
agreements for the development of subdivisions. For your convenience the bond forms
provided are fill-able PDF form files. The fill-able PDF allows the information to be entered into
the application while online by tabbing through the form and entering applicable information.
The form is designed to allow you to save it and/or make further changes in it if you wish.
It is necessary that you provide one original and one copy of the bond and the agreement with
a certified copy of power of attorney attached to each set.

Bond Agreement Form for Subdivisions
(Surety Bond in Lieu of Immediate Construction)
STATE OF LOUISIANA
PARISH OF EAST BATON ROUGE
THIS AGREEMENT, made and entered into this day of 20 , by and
between , hereinafter designated as
Developer/Owner, and the City of Baton Rouge and/or Parish of East Baton Rouge, Louisiana, herein represented by
Mayor-President.
W I T N E S S E T H:
WHEREAS, the Developer/Owner owns and desires to develop Lots through
of the Subdivision, Filing, located in the City of Baton Rouge
and/or Parish of East Baton Rouge, Louisiana; and, WHEREAS, the final plat will be recommended for final approval
by the Department of Development and the Planning Commission of the City of Baton Rouge and/or the Parish of
East Baton Rouge upon Developer/Owner posting a surety bond insuring the satisfactory installation and
construction of the following improvements:
(Describe improvements as determined by Department of Development)
As shown on the plat prepared by , attached hereto and made a part hereof,
and according to the terms and conditions of this agreement,
The Developer/Owner now desires final approval of the plat of
Subdivision, Filing, prior to the installation and construction of the above-described improvements,
which improvements will be installed and constructed at Developer’s/Owner’s sole cost and expense.
NOW, THEREFORE, it is hereby agreed by and between the Developer/Owner and the City of Baton Rouge and/or
Parish of East Baton Rouge that for and in consideration of the final approval of Lots through
, inclusive, of the Subdivision,
Filing, and the sale of said lots therein without the above-described improvements more particularly shown on the
attached plan profile having been first completed and approved, Developer/Owner binds and obligates himself
within 12 (twelve) months from date hereof to install and construct the described improvements in accordance with
plans prepared by , which plans meet the requirements of the Louisiana
State Board of Health and have been approved by the Director of the Department of Development of the City of
Baton Rouge and Parish of East Baton Rouge, which plans are attached hereto and made a part hereof.
The Developer/Owner, in order to further ensure faithful performance of said obligation, has executed a surety bond
in the amount of $ , which bond is attached hereto and made a part hereof, to guarantee
the installation and construction of the following improvements:
(Describe improvements same as above)
THEREFORE, said surety bond may be canceled only after said work has been constructed and completed in
accordance with plans and specifications, inspected and approved by written acceptance of the Director of
Development of the City of Baton Rouge and the Parish of East Baton Rouge.

with a certificate of satisfactory completion.

and/or Parish of East Baton Rouge shall have the right to cause the improvements to be made and to call upon said
